import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top-left: Sales by Product
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_sales))
axes[0, 0].barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v, i, f' ${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Top-right: Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = age_sales.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_sales.index])
colors_age = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(age_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                            autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                            colors=colors_age, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 3. Bottom-left: Average Transaction Value by Payment Method and Size
payment_size = df.groupby(['payment_method', 'size'])['total'].mean().reset_index()
pivot_data = payment_size.pivot(index='payment_method', columns='size', values='total')
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = pivot_data[[col for col in size_order if col in pivot_data.columns]]
x = np.arange(len(pivot_data.index))
width = 0.25
colors_size = ['#8dd3c7', '#fb8072', '#bebada']
for i, col in enumerate(pivot_data.columns):
    axes[1, 0].bar(x + i*width, pivot_data[col], width, label=col, color=colors_size[i])
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Transaction Value by Payment Method and Size', 
                      fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(x + width)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(pivot_data.index, rotation=0)
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Size', fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Bottom-right: Takeaway vs Dine-in Analysis
df['order_type'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({1: 'Takeaway', 0: 'Dine-in'})
takeaway_stats = df.groupby('order_type').agg({
    'total': ['sum', 'mean', 'count']
}).reset_index()
takeaway_stats.columns = ['order_type', 'total_sales', 'avg_transaction', 'count']

ax2 = axes[1, 1]
x_pos = np.arange(len(takeaway_stats))
bar_width = 0.35

# Sales bars
bars1 = ax2.bar(x_pos - bar_width/2, takeaway_stats['total_sales'], bar_width, 
                label='Total Sales', color='#2E86AB', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#2E86AB')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#2E86AB')

# Create second y-axis for transaction count
ax2_twin = ax2.twinx()
bars2 = ax2_twin.bar(x_pos + bar_width/2, takeaway_stats['count'], bar_width, 
                      label='Transaction Count', color='#A23B72', alpha=0.8)
ax2_twin.set_ylabel('Transaction Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#A23B72')
ax2_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#A23B72')

ax2.set_xlabel('Order Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in: Sales & Transactions', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax2.set_xticklabels(takeaway_stats['order_type'])
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Combined legend
lines1, labels1 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2_twin.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax2.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
